I hope whatever decision you make gives you the healthcare, security and peace of mind you need. ❤️🏴

comments.text: "Other countries visit their past on weekends. The Welsh hang their laundry inside it." What the HELL is THAT? It's AI slop again, in case you didn't notice the miniscule warning. God, I hate this formulaic AI scripting--the tortured, florid writing, the impossible similes. And worst, there's no actual sound, just fake bird sounds and waves sounds, generic music, and no matter how often they talk about the miners singing and the male choirs, there's no audio of them!!!. This is nothing more than travelogue videos with cheap narration. And the biggest problem is that Wales is great, but this is ruinous garbage. Wales deserves better. We deserve better than this cheap, cranked-out AI garbage.
